title: BPSC CCE Syllabus 2026 – Prelims & Mains
vacancyDetails: Prelims GS; Mains GS, Hindi, Optional and Essay as per BPSC scheme
ageLimit: Minimum 20/21/22 years post-wise; maximum as per BPSC rules
documentsRequired: Download official syllabus PDF; keep notification for pattern updates
howToApply:
1. Visit https://www.bpsc.bih.nic.in
2. Open CCE advertisement / syllabus
3. Download Prelims and Mains syllabus PDFs
4. Focus on Bihar special topics
5. Prepare Optional thoroughly for Mains
shortDescription: BPSC CCE Syllabus – Prelims General Studies; Mains General Hindi, General Studies, Essay and Optional papers.
content:
BPSC Combined Competitive Examination syllabus is notified with each CCE advertisement.

Prelims (objective)

General Studies – single paper covering: General Science; Current events of national & international importance; History of India and Bihar; Geography of India and Bihar; Indian Polity & Economy; Indian National Movement and Bihar’s contribution; General Mental Ability.

Mains (written)

  • General Hindi (qualifying as per rules)
  • General Studies Paper 1 & 2
  • Essay
  • Optional subject papers

GS Mains includes Modern History of India & Indian culture, Current events, Statistical analysis, Indian Polity, Indian Economy, Geography of India with Bihar focus, Science & Technology, etc. as detailed in the official syllabus.

Source: bpsc.bih.nic.in / bpsconline.bihar.gov.in.
